reviews.t: Seller is not sending you the item pictured in listing
reviews.x: The picture in listing is a Caboodle. What you will receive is a knockoff. The color is not lilac but purple. The plastic is not hard like the take it touch up tote but instead a cheap, flexible piece of garbage. Last of all, the Caboodles label or brand is not present because it is counterfeit. Compare the label in the listing with my photo. Not even close! If you want an authentic Caboodle, don't by this. If you don't care about paying the same amount for a knock off then do as you wish.
The item I received doesn’t look like the product shown. It is darker purple and has a made-up “Caboodles” logo on it.

The item I received didn't look like the picture. The color is a lot darker and it had a totally different sticker (which had already fallen off when I received the package). I was going to give this to a friend for the nostalgia factor but I don't think she'll like it at all.

reviews.t: So far so good, with some limitations
reviews.x: I ordered one as a Christmas present for one of the teen girls in the family .  when it came in and I decided it was so cute that I had to order one for another young lady and also got myself one:)  I do wish it was packaged better, the unit was just tossed into a box with thin plastic wrap around it. The peach colored one came with visible scratches.  They were not bad enough to warrant being returned but they are still there.  The colors are super cute  and they seem authentic.  Not sure what

We're you born in the 80's? Do you miss fishnets and scrunchies? If so, the product is for you. Upon receiving the package I was immediately transported back to the blue eyeshadow days with Michael Jackson playing in the background. Thank you Caboodles. Thank you
I'm a child of the 80's and when I saw this darling Caboodles case I just had to buy one for my daughter and daughter-in-law. Still the cutest little makeup case and the perfect size for on-the-go!

It is size I expected but holds much less than I had hoped. The design isn’t so great because when you close it, the top tray fits into the bottom tray, and takes up most of the space. There’s not much room in the bottom tray to store things if you want to be able to close it up.

Can’t fit any makeup and close. No compacts, no eyelash curlers, no powders, no palettes. If you have super tiny makeup it might fit but then why not just use a pouch? Total junk and not worth the hassle to send it back. I donated it.
Came broken and wrapped. Do not buy. They are fake or either old. Not made with my high quality of the rest of the Kaboodle line

reviews.t: Works great as a teacher's pencil case
reviews.x: This was really my co-worker's idea.  She showed up at a conference with this, and it was full of pens, highlighters, sticky notes, white out tape, etc.  It was so cute and it had a mirror!!!  I was so impressed that I asked her about it and found out it was Caboodles!!!  Who knew?  What a great way to carry school supplies in my bag without them getting damaged or leaking or lost at the bottom of the bag!  Love it!

I have to move desks often and I like to take my own pens and supplies. This is much better than digging around in a pouch. Bonus.. the mirror keeps people from sneaking up behind me and all my supplies are organized and easy to get to.
Does not match the photo. This is not a real Caboodles item. I wanted to give these to friends as a fun, nostalgic gift for Christmas, but I won’t be doing that. I do not recommend buying this.
Small enough to fit in a big purse, and great to store all the lipsticks that are usually rolling around at the bottom of my bag! I love the color, and the added mirror.
I bought this to take on a trip it arrived broken. I'm hoping to be able to exchange it for a new one. Otherwise it's very cute and nostalgic

This case arrived well packaged with no damage. This case is very small and somewhat thin so you’re not fitting much of anything inside of it, unless the items are very small themselves, otherwise the case won’t close or latch shut at all. I was Able to fit a few small things inside and still managed to easily close it. I wanted something small and portable so I could easily grab it and go, so far this seems to do the job. Not super sturdy, so definitely don’t drop or put too many items inside,

I like this container. I’m going to use it to hold hair doodads. I tried to put my makeup inside it, but found that most of my stuff wouldn’t really fit. So for me it’s a nice container, but not for makeup. Maybe small liners and lipsticks would work as well. Or small brushes. I could also use it to store pens for travel journaling. I did like that it has a mirror inside the lid. Shipping was quick and the case was in good condition when I received it. I have had no issues with it.
I was so excited to get this and use for my trip and it’s broken! So I guess their products are not as well made as they used to be. I am disappointed!
Love my caboodle and you can’t beat this price but it doesn’t close very well but I can adjust with how cute and inexpensive it was.
Cool and doesn’t spill Sitting on the mirror ledge at work. Just what I needed. Also retro, which is cool if you were born in 81.
Honestly a little larger than I anticipated, it’s super hard so I don’t think it’ll break while traveling
Love this little case.  Bought them for my nieces for Christmas. I personalized them.  Turned out great
Always loved caboodles, now it is my granddaughters first makeup case as well! She loves it too

reviews.t: Very durable, holds Alot, easy to handle.
reviews.x: I still have a caboodle from high school...

reviews.t: Cute and compact but not as useful as I'd like
reviews.x: I bought this to keep a few essential makeup items in my desk at work for touch ups. This is cute and compact like I wanted but you can't fit a liquid foundation in it. Another problem I have is when you take out something from the bottom tray, it tends to be top heavy and falls backwards. Mind you all I have is 2 small brushes and an eyeliner in the top tray and there's still stuff in the bottom tray when it does this. I probably wouldn't buy this again and would look for something else.

I bought this as a gift for my great niece, who is getting into makeup and makeup tools. She loves purple, so the color was right. This was supposed to be for her makeup brushes, but it wasn't quite long enough. She liked it, but she will probably use it for something else. I ended up buying her a larger Caboodles case on Amazon and having it shipped directly to her, which thrilled her, and she really loves the new case, too!

claims.text: Several reviewers say the item received does not match the listing photo, describing it as a darker purple counterfeit or knockoff without the real Caboodles branding.
Some reviewers report the case arrived broken or poorly packaged.
Many reviewers find the case too small and thin to hold much makeup, with the tray taking up most of the space so it won't close.
Reviewers praise the nostalgic 80s appeal and cute design, often buying multiples as gifts.
Some reviewers use it successfully as a pencil or supply case, appreciating the mirror and organization.
